column1: # Seed dictionary for public.classify_item (German). Format: term<TAB>category.
# Terms go through public.item_key, so list one form when the stem covers the
# plural (Gurke/Gurken) and both for -er plurals (Ei/Eier, Teelicht/Teelichter).
# A word matches the longest term it ends with, so short heads (milch, saft,
# gel, creme, spray, mittel, bürste, tücher) carry compounds; compounds whose
# head would mislead are listed explicitly (kokosmilch, sonnenmilch, spargel).
# Compounds of tee and keks are listed explicitly: their stems (eiste,
# butterkek) no longer end in the short term. Reis, Eis and Mais keep their s,
# Frozen markers (TK, Tiefkühl-, tiefgekühlt, gefroren) beat the food word in
# public.dictionary_category, so they are not listed here.
# - Hafer-, Soja-, Mandelmilch and -drinks sit in the Kühlregal next to milk.
# - Coffee and tea (incl. tea compounds) are pantry; ready-to-drink is drinks.
# - Spreads (Marmelade, Honig, Nutella, Erdnussbutter) are pantry.
# - Baby food, formula and baby care are Drogerie; Taschentücher too.
# - Toilet paper, Küchenrolle and cleaning cloths are Haushalt. So is pet food
#   (Katzenfutter, Hundefutter, Katzenstreu), which shares the non-food aisle.
# - Bags (-beutel, -tüte) are Haushalt; Filtertüten sit with the coffee.
# - Brand names stand for their product (Elmex, Frosch, Somat, Lenor).
# Regional and English synonyms live in synonyms.tsv (job 32a); spelling variants and typos are
# folded and matched by public.classify_item_detail, so do not list misspellings here.
# - Snack nuts (Erdnüsse, Cashews, Pistazien) are sweets; baking nuts pantry.
# - Canned fish (Thunfisch, Sardinen) is pantry; fresh and smoked fish is meat.
# - Fresh pasta, dough and deli salads are chilled; Erbsen default to frozen.
# - Fresh herbs are produce; dried spices are pantry.
# - DIY words (job 151) have seven categories, which a household gets with a Baumarkt store;
#   without one public.classify_item_detail puts them in Haushalt. Glühbirne, Lampe, Kabel,
#   Kabelbinder, Stecker, Sicherung, Abdeckband, Erde, Blumenerde and Dünger moved there from
#   Haushalt, Farbe from Drogerie. What the supermarket sells stays Haushalt: Batterien,
#   Grillkohle, Kerzen, Eimer, Gummihandschuhe, and Klebeband and Kleber (parcels, crafts).
# Wooden kitchen things (holz, brett): Nudelholz, Holzlöffel, Schneidebrett stay Haushalt.
# Kitchen tools whose head is a DIY term (zange, hammer, hobel, spachtel, silikon prefix, schaufel):
# Cosmetic brushes, colours and nails whose head is a DIY term (pinsel, farbe, nägel, zange, erde):
# farbe is wall paint now; Haarfarbe, Tönung and Lebensmittelfarbe are listed with their aisles.
# Spray and roller compounds are listed: spray is Drogerie and rolle Haushalt on their own.
# A bare Pinselset stays paint: the sets at both shops are sold as such, and a make-up set is
# usually typed with its kind (Make-up Pinselset ends in pinselset but starts with make up).
# Mischbatterie is a tap, not a battery; Klobrille a seat, not glasses. A bare Schlauch is left
# out: Fahrradschlauch is neither garden nor plumbing.
# Batteries and Akkus stay Haushalt (the supermarket checkout); Lampenöl too. Birne alone is a
# pear, so the bulb compounds are listed.
# Schraubendreher and -schlüssel are listed: they start with schraube. Kelle and Feile alone are
# the kitchen's and the nail file; Waage alone is the kitchen scale.
# Nagellack, Nagelschere, Nagelfeile and Nagelknipser stay Drogerie (their own terms). Seil is
# rope from the reel; Wäscheseil stays Haushalt.
# Latte alone stays out (Caffè Latte); Platte and Brett too (Käseplatte, Schneidebrett).
# Montageschaum is listed: schaum is Drogerie on its own.
# Samen alone stays pantry (Leinsamen), so seed compounds are listed; Blumenzwiebel too
# (zwiebel is produce). Pflanzenöl is pantry. Vogelfutter stays with the pet food in Haushalt.
